name: models_search
description:
Search the 3D model library by words and filters. Keywords: buscar modelo, encuentra mi STL, figura de.
Search the user's 3D model library by words (name, tags, notes, folder, listing text) with filters: format, tag, collection, watertight, has_listing, duplicates, size in mm. Returns id, name, format, bbox (mm), triangles, tags, has_listing and thumb_url per hit. Ranking sorts (-extent, -volume, -size, -triangles, -date) fold identical files into one hit with a 'copies' count, so 'the three biggest' are three different models. First step for 'find my model of X'.
Sinónimos: buscar modelo, modelo 3D, STL, 3MF, OBJ, impresión 3D, archivo, figura, pieza, buscar en mis modelos, cuál era, carpeta de modelos, etiquetas, tamaño en mm, miniatura.

name: collection_plan
description:
Plan sorting a folder's items into group folders from a pasted list (read-only). Keywords: organizar.
No model: matches each immediate child of the folder to a member of the list (formats in reference), ignoring case, accents, separators and number prefixes like 0001_. Returns the target folder per group with the items moving in, items already in place, unmatched, ambiguous and conflicts, plus a plan_id for collection_apply. Nothing is moved.
Sinónimos: organizar colección, agrupar carpetas, una carpeta por línea evolutiva, ordenar por lista, meter en carpetas, carpeta por grupo, números con ceros.

ignore_number_prefix.title: Ignore Number Prefix

allow_contains.title: Allow Contains

name: collection_apply
description:
Apply a stored collection plan: create group folders and move the items in (write). Keywords: aplicar plan.
Carries out a plan from collection_plan by id: creates the group folders and moves the matched items into them. Never deletes and never overwrites (a collision is skipped and reported), re-checks the disk at apply time, writes an undo journal and queues a rescan of the affected root. Only when the user agrees to the plan.
Sinónimos: aplicar plan, mover a carpetas, ejecutar la organización, crear carpetas por grupo, ordenar de verdad.

name: collection_undo
description:
Undo the last collection_apply (or a given one) by moving every item back (write). Keywords: deshacer.
Reverses an apply from its journal: moves each item back to where it was, never overwriting anything (an occupied original location is skipped and reported), then removes the group folders the apply created if they are empty again. Defaults to the most recent apply that is not undone. Queues a rescan.
Sinónimos: deshacer organización, revertir, volver atrás, devolver los archivos a su sitio, deshacer el último cambio.

apply_id.description: Id returned by collection_apply; omit to undo the most recent apply that is not undone yet.

remove_created_folders.description: After moving the items back, remove the group folders that the apply created if they are empty again (never a folder with anything inside).

name: cad_from_text
description:
Design a 3D part from a text description or a spec and add it to the library (write). Keywords: diseña pieza.
Builds a parametric part in millimetres (boxes, cylinders, spheres, holes, unions/differences, patterns) from a description (a local model writes the spec, validated, with one repair attempt) or from a spec you pass. Saves STL + spec + check render into the library as a new model, and returns the measured bounding box, volume, watertightness and a check against the requested measures. save=false only measures. Report the measured numbers, not the intended ones.
Sinónimos: diseña una pieza, crea un modelo 3D, texto a CAD, modelo paramétrico, hazme una placa con agujeros, soporte, caja, cilindro, generar STL, medidas en mm.

name: model_compare
description:

Never rescales or mirrors to align. File units are used when declared; auto otherwise reports an explicit mm assumption. ICP is local and sampled agreement is not a proof of identity or manufacturing tolerance.
Sinónimos: comparar revisiones, agujero nuevo, diferencia geométrica, cambio de forma, alinear piezas.

name: model_simplify
description:
Make a lighter LOD variant of a model: fewer triangles, measured error (write). Keywords: simplificar.
meshoptimizer (fallbacks fast-simplification, clustering) to a ratio and/or target_error = max surface deviation in mm, measured as the reported error.hausdorff_mm (target_met; a miss is not saved). Open borders locked and checked (borders_kept). Writes a NEW STL linked to the source (original untouched), identified by a hash of parameters + source revision (variant_key). save=false only measures.
Sinónimos: simplificar malla, reducir triángulos, diezmar, LOD, versión ligera, aligerar STL, menos polígonos, optimizar modelo.

id.title: Id

ratio.title: Ratio

target_error.description: Maximum SURFACE deviation in mm (e.g. 0.05), measured as error.hausdorff_mm (two-sided sampled distance, the number the result reports): results are measured and the engine tightened until it holds; target_met says if it did. 0/null = no maximum. With ratio too, the ratio is the floor of kept triangles.
target_error.title: Target Error

mode.description: attribute = quality quadric simplification; sloppy = much faster and rougher (topology may change).
mode.title: Mode

keep_borders.description: Lock open-border vertices and edges so outlines do not move (every engine, checked in borders_kept).

name: gulliver_model_create

The report carries a printability score and advice.

method.description: Volume reconstructs a closed voxel surface; surface uses classic cleanup. Volume may smooth fine details or merge nearby parts.
